items.title: VMware ESX 日志记录不足可被绕过
items.title_zh: VMware ESX 日志记录不足可被绕过
items.summary_zh: 具备管理员权限的恶意者可利用日志记录缺陷执行操作而不留审计痕迹，削弱溯源与合规能力
items.affected: Broadcom(产品与版本待 NVD/厂商补充)
items.action_zh: 关注Broadcom官方补丁；收敛管理员权限并外发审计日志
items.repro_note: 需ESX管理员凭据，执行敏感操作后检查对应日志缺失
items.impact_scope: 虚拟化宿主机，高权限滥用与合规风险
items.description: VMware ESX contains an insufficient logging vulnerability. A malicious administrator could exploit this issue to perform certain operations without them being logged.

items.title: Linux内核 skbuff合并标记丢失
items.title_zh: Linux内核 skbuff合并标记丢失
items.summary_zh: 攻击者可触发skb合并丢失共享分片标记，使页缓存或外部内存被误写，造成内核内存破坏
items.difficulty: 高(需本地访问·需低权限)
items.action_zh: 升级内核至 5.15.208/5.10.257 及以上修复版本
items.repro_note: 构造带SKBFL_SHARED_FRAG的skb触发coalesce，需本地或收包路径
items.impact_scope: Linux主机内核，本地提权与内存破坏
items.description: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: net: skbuff: preserve shared-frag marker during coalescing skb_try_coalesce() can attach paged frags from @from to @to. If @from has SKBFL_SHARED_FRAG set, the resulting @to skb can contain the same externally-owned or page-cache-backed frags, but the shared-frag marker is currently lost.

items.title: Juniper SSC 命令注入RCE
items.summary_zh: 远程攻击者可向AutomatedProvisioner提交特制salt minion ID注入命令，以root身份执行任意指令
items.affected: Juniper(产品与版本待 NVD/厂商补充)
items.action_zh: 升级至Juniper修复版本，限制Conductor管理面暴露
items.repro_note: 向Conductor的Salt接入端口提交特制minion ID触发命令注入
items.impact_scope: SD-WAN控制器，管理面暴露风险高
items.description: An Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command vulnerability in the AutomatedProvisioner in Juniper Networks Session Smart Conductor allows a remote attacker to execute arbitrary commands as root via a specially crafted salt minion ID.

items.title: Juniper SSR 未认证接口可获管理员
items.title_zh: Juniper SSR 未认证接口可获管理员
items.summary_zh: 设备未纳管至Mist/Conductor前，攻击者向root权限端点传入构造URL参数即可获取管理员权限
items.affected: Juniper(产品与版本待 NVD/厂商补充)
items.action_zh: 升级修复版本；新设备上线前隔离管理面并限制访问
items.repro_note: 未认证访问root运行的端点并构造URL参数，仅限未纳管设备
items.impact_scope: SD-WAN边缘路由器，常暴露于公网
items.description: A Missing authentication for critical function vulnerability in Juniper Networks Session Smart Router allows an unauthenticated network-based attacker to obtain administrative privileges by passing crafted URL parameters to an insecure endpoint running as root. Note that this vulnerability can only be exploited prior to the device being onboarded to Mist/Conductor. The issue can no longer be exploited once a device is onboarded to Mist/Conductor.
